posts.text: Nvidia's NVDA perpetual futures slid 3.8% to 180.50 USD on Hyperliquid, with 24-hour volume of 170M USD, after the chipmaker's board opened an inquiry into CEO Jensen Huang over a reported Chinese intelligence link.
